echo | openssl s_client -connect cpd-bawuat.apps.ocpautotst.domain.edbe.local:443 \
  -servername cpd-bawuat.apps.ocpautotst.domain.edbe.local -showcerts 2>/dev/null \
  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates


# Is a custom default certificate configured at all?
oc get ingresscontroller default -n openshift-ingress-operator \
  -o jsonpath='{.spec.defaultCertificate}'

# If empty/absent → the router is presenting its auto-generated self-signed cert.
# Inspect what it actually serves:
oc get secret router-certs-default -n openshift-ingress \
  -o jsonpath='{.data.tls\.crt}' | base64 -d \
  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates

# Also check whether this specific route overrides with its own cert:
oc get route cpd-bawuat  -o jsonpath='{.spec.tls}'
